chapters.label: Oct 2026
chapters.name: Built
chapters.line: Sixteen days from the first commit to an x-ray traders use. Every card links the commit that shipped it.

zh.label: 2026 年 10 月
zh.name: 已建成
zh.line: 从第一次提交到交易者每天在用的透视，用了十六天。每张卡片都链接到上线它的那次提交。

chapters.label: Nov 2026
chapters.name: Own ground
chapters.line: Our own machines, the holder radar and the money map, a swap and a pro tier that pay for the zoo, and the first vote.

zh.label: 2026 年 11 月
zh.name: 自己的地盘
zh.line: 自己的服务器，持有者雷达和资金流向图，让项目自给自足的兑换和专业版，以及第一次投票。

chapters.label: Dec 2026
chapters.name: Guard
chapters.line: A seatbelt for agents that trade alone, and two builds in the order holders choose.

zh.label: 2026 年 12 月
zh.name: 守卫
zh.line: 给独自交易的智能体系上安全带，以及按持有者选定顺序完成的两个项目。

chapters.label: No date
chapters.name: Exploring
chapters.line: Ideas we are working on that depend on others or on what we learn first. No date until there is one.

zh.label: 暂无日期
zh.name: 探索中
zh.line: 取决于合作方或我们先学到什么的想法。有日期之前不写日期。

items.title: Agents with permissions
items.text: An agent's species is what it may do, enforced by the runtime. Signed signals, budgets, a hash-chained public log.

zh.title: 带权限的智能体
zh.text: 物种决定一个智能体能做什么，由运行时强制执行。签名信号、预算、哈希链公开日志。

items.title: Morning Brief
items.text: Out every day at 07:00 UTC with no human in the loop, every issue hashed and archived.

zh.title: 早报
zh.text: 每天 UTC 07:00 自动发布，无人参与，每一期都有哈希并存档。

items.title: Judges graded in public
items.text: Every call is re-checked the next day and the score is public. The beaver rewrites its own playbook from it.

zh.title: 公开打分的评委
zh.text: 每个判断第二天都会被复查，分数公开。海狸根据分数重写自己的规则手册。

items.title: Bring your own agent
items.text: Outside agents move in with a Solana wallet and earn a public record. A wing for ClawPump agents.

zh.title: 带上你自己的智能体
zh.text: 外部智能体用一个 Solana 钱包入驻，赢得公开战绩。ClawPump 智能体有专属区。

items.title: Reading Solana directly
items.text: Every pump.fun launch and trade straight from a Yellowstone stream, not from someone else's API.

zh.title: 直接读取 Solana
zh.text: 每一个 pump.fun 发射和交易都直接来自 Yellowstone 数据流，而不是别人的 API。

items.title: Judges that evolve
items.text: Eight judges sit the same exam every night. The weakest dies, the strongest breed.

zh.title: 会进化的评委
zh.text: 八个评委每晚参加同一场考试。最弱的死去，最强的繁衍。

items.title: Wall of rugs
items.text: The devs who dumped the most of their own launches in 48 hours, each with the transaction.

zh.title: 跑路墙
zh.text: 48 小时内砸盘自己发射次数最多的开发者，每一笔都附交易。

items.title: Bundle detection
items.text: Wallets that buy together in one block, how much supply they took and how much they still hold.

zh.title: 捆绑检测
zh.text: 在同一个区块里一起买入的钱包，拿走了多少供应，现在还剩多少。

items.title: Telegram bot and app
items.text: Paste a CA in any chat. Watch a token and get pinged when the dev dumps or the pool drains.

zh.title: Telegram 机器人和小程序
zh.text: 在任何群里粘贴合约地址。关注一个代币，开发者砸盘或池子被抽干时提醒你。

items.title: Humans vs the beaver
items.text: People answer the same nightly exam as the AI, graded the same way. Weekly standings, SOL prizes.

zh.title: 人类对战海狸
zh.text: 人和 AI 回答同一场夜间考试，用同样的方式打分。每周排名，SOL 奖励。

items.title: Holders hear first
items.text: Holders of $ZOOAGENCY get alerts at once, everyone else later. More asks, more watched tokens.

zh.title: 持有者先知道
zh.text: $ZOOAGENCY 持有者立刻收到提醒，其他人稍后。更多提问次数，更多关注代币。

items.title: Holders vote the gene
items.text: Every week holders pick a rule for the next newborn judge. Balance read at the close too, the smaller counts.

zh.title: 持有者投票基因
zh.text: 每周持有者为下一个新生评委选一条规则。结束时再读一次余额，取较小值。

items.title: 中文
items.text: The site, the bot and the alerts in Simplified Chinese.

zh.title: 中文
zh.text: 网站、机器人和提醒全部支持简体中文。

items.title: Drained pools
items.text: A graduated coin whose pool falls to a fifth of its best is called out, on the map and in alerts.

zh.title: 池子被抽干
zh.text: 已毕业代币的池子跌到峰值的五分之一，地图和提醒里都会标出来。

items.title: LaunchLab and Meteora
items.text: Raydium LaunchLab and Meteora's curve read from the chain, beside pump.fun.

zh.title: LaunchLab 和 Meteora
zh.text: Raydium LaunchLab 和 Meteora 的曲线直接从链上读取，与 pump.fun 并列。

items.title: X-Ray
items.text: The dev's history, who funded them, the first five seconds as a radar, snipers that turn out to be the dev.

zh.title: 透视
zh.text: 开发者的历史，谁给他打的钱，前五秒的雷达图，以及其实就是开发者本人的狙击手。

items.title: API for builders
items.text: A verdict in one call, a free tier, and a holder key signed with one wallet signature.

zh.title: 开发者 API
zh.text: 一次调用得到判断，有免费额度，持有者用一次钱包签名就能拿到密钥。

items.title: Chrome extension
items.text: The x-ray on gmgn, Axiom, pump.fun and DexScreener, and a tag next to every CA on X.

zh.title: Chrome 插件
zh.text: 在 gmgn、Axiom、pump.fun 和 DexScreener 上直接透视，X 上每个合约地址旁都有标记。

items.title: Our own chain relay
items.text: The cloud saw a tenth of pump.fun. A relay on our own machine sees all of it.

zh.title: 自己的链上中继
zh.text: 云服务器只能看到 pump.fun 的十分之一。我们自己机器上的中继能看到全部。

items.title: Our numbers, in public
items.text: Usage by day as it is, and how often coins we flagged really died.

zh.title: 公开我们的数字
zh.text: 每天的真实使用量，以及我们标记的代币里有多少真的死了。

items.title: X-Ray as a terminal
items.text: One frame: the ticker, the verdict and the stream light on top, the read tabs down the left, four tiles and the reasons in the middle, the trade on the right, the chain's receipt at the bottom. The frame's light takes the verdict's colour.

zh.title: 终端式透视
zh.text: 一个框：顶部是代币、判断和数据流状态，左边是查看标签，中间是四块数据和理由，右边是交易，底部是链上凭据。框的光带随判断变色。

items.title: Our own servers
items.text: Every node moved onto machines we run, next to the relay that reads Solana for us. No shared cloud, keys only we hold.
items.why: Our cloud host had a security incident in October. The nodes kept running, but a tool that tells people who to trust should not depend on someone else's keys. Since October 22 they run on our own server.

zh.title: 自己的服务器
zh.text: 所有节点已迁到我们自己的机器上，和为我们读取 Solana 的中继放在一起。不用共享云，密钥只在我们手里。
zh.why: 我们的云服务商十月出了安全事件。节点一直在运行，但一个告诉别人该信谁的工具，不应该依赖别人的密钥。从 10 月 22 日起，节点跑在我们自己的服务器上。

items.title: This roadmap
items.text: One file in the repo. Shipped means a commit, buried means a reason, and every edit to the plan is in the git history.

zh.title: 这份路线图
zh.text: 仓库里的一个文件。已上线意味着有提交，被放弃意味着有理由，计划的每一次修改都在 git 历史里。

items.title: Holder radar
items.text: Fresh coins with no red flags so far, for holders. The moment one turns, the dev dumps, the bundles leave, the pool drains, it goes red and you are pinged first.
items.why: Live on the site for holders and, since 28 October, in Telegram: /radar on in the bot, and every coin that passed is re-checked each minute until it turns or ages out; the ping names the reason.

zh.title: 持有者雷达
zh.text: 目前没有红旗的新币，只给持有者看。一旦变了，开发者砸盘、捆绑撤离、池子被抽干，它立刻变红，你第一个收到提醒。
zh.why: 已在网站上对持币者开放，自 10 月 28 日起也在 Telegram 里：在机器人里发 /radar on，每个通过检查的币每分钟重新检查，直到变脸或过期；提醒里写明原因。

items.title: Money map
items.text: One look at a whole operation, left to right: who funded the dev, the dev, their own snipers and bundles in the first seconds, and who has already sold. Below it, where the SOL went after the dump: what the dev and its wallets sent out in the day after the launch, to an exchange, back to whoever paid the dev, to wallets that launch coins, or on to a wallet that collects from other devs.
items.why: A dump is not the end of the story. Proceeds that go back to the wallet that paid the dev, or into a wallet other devs pay into, are one operator running many coins. Proceeds that go to an exchange deposit end there, on the record.

zh.title: 资金流向图
zh.text: 一眼看清整个操盘过程，从左到右：谁给开发者打的钱，开发者本人，前几秒里他自己的狙击号和捆绑号，以及谁已经卖出。下面是砸盘后 SOL 去了哪里：开发者和他的钱包在发币后一天内转出的钱，转进交易所、回到给开发者打钱的钱包、转给发币的钱包，或者转到另有其他开发者打钱进去的钱包。
zh.why: 砸盘不是故事的结尾。回到给开发者打钱的钱包，或者转进其他开发者也往里打钱的钱包，说明是一个操盘手在跑很多币。转进交易所充值地址的钱，就停在那里，留在记录上。

items.title: Odds instead of a label
items.text: Every pump.fun X-Ray now gives two numbers from its first five minutes: the chance the coin climbs past 85 SOL market cap, and the chance the dev still dumps, each with what moved it. Once it ran, or an hour on, it shows what happened instead.
items.why: Our own record showed that avoid and pass die at almost the same rate on pump.fun, so a label alone ranks nothing. Two models fitted on 34,183 launches do: the top tenth by these odds climbed past 85 SOL seven times as often as the average launch.

zh.title: 用概率代替标签
zh.text: 现在每个 pump.fun 透视都会根据前五分钟给出两个数字：市值涨过 85 SOL 的概率，以及开发者之后还会砸盘的概率，并说明是什么影响了它们。上涨之后或一小时后，显示实际发生了什么。
zh.why: 我们自己的记录显示，在 pump.fun 上被标记回避和没有被标记的币死亡率几乎一样，所以只有标签排不出顺序。基于 34,183 个发币拟合的两个模型可以：概率排在前十分之一的币，市值涨过 85 SOL 的次数是普通币的七倍。

items.title: Swap inside the X-Ray
items.text: Buy or sell the coin you just checked without leaving the page, routed through Jupiter, signed in your own wallet, nothing held by us. A 1% fee in SOL: a tenth of it buys $ZOOAGENCY back, the rest keeps the zoo running. The verdict sits right above the buy button.
items.why: We will never tell you what to buy. But you were going to buy it anyway, so now the check and the buy are two clicks apart, and the warning sits right on the button.

zh.title: 透视页面内直接兑换
zh.text: 买卖刚查过的币不用离开页面：Jupiter 路由，你自己的钱包签名，我们不托管任何资产。1% 的 SOL 手续费：十分之一回购 $ZOOAGENCY，其余维持动物园运转。判断就在买入按钮正上方。
zh.why: 我们永远不会告诉你该买什么。但你本来就要买，所以现在检查和买入只隔两下点击，警告就在按钮上。

items.title: One tap to where you trade
items.text: Axiom, GMGN, BullX, Padre, pump.fun and FOMO open on this coin from under the verdict, in the X-Ray and in the Telegram bot. Copy CA sits next to the ticker.

zh.title: 一键去你交易的地方
zh.text: Axiom、GMGN、BullX、Padre、pump.fun 和 FOMO 在判断下方直接打开这个币，透视页和 Telegram 机器人里都有。复制合约地址就在代币旁边。

items.title: Launches read after the fact
items.text: A coin older than the 48-hour tape can be read from the chain into the 90-day memory, and the X-Ray then reads it like any other. Launchpads are named: ClawPump's launcher and Launch's deployer wallet are the platform's, not a ring and not launch spam.

zh.title: 事后补读的发射
zh.text: 比 48 小时实时带更老的币可以从链上补读进 90 天记忆，透视页随后像读其他币一样读它。发射平台被点名：ClawPump 的发射钱包和 Launch 的部署钱包属于平台，不是团伙，也不是刷币。

items.title: BNB Chain: four.meme
items.text: The same x-ray on BNB Chain. Every four.meme launch, buy, sell and graduation read straight from the chain's logs: the dev's record, the launch-block bundle, the first-seconds wallets, churn. Paste a 0x address anywhere the x-ray lives: the site, the bot, the extension.
items.why: Every chain we add, we read straight from the chain like Solana, not from someone else's API. four.meme first, because that is where BNB Chain launches happen; holders and who paid for the dev come next.

zh.title: BNB Chain：four.meme
zh.text: 同样的透视来到 BNB Chain。每一次 four.meme 的发币、买入、卖出和毕业都直接从链上日志读取：开发者的记录、开盘区块捆绑、前几秒的钱包、刷量。在网站、机器人、扩展里任何能透视的地方粘贴 0x 地址即可。
zh.why: 每增加一条链，我们都像 Solana 一样直接读链上数据，而不是用别人的 API。先做 four.meme，因为 BNB Chain 的发币都在那里；持币者和谁给开发者打钱是下一步。

items.title: Pro
items.text: The verdict and its main reasons stay free for everyone. Pro opens the deep x-ray, every wallet, the first five seconds radar, who funded the dev, plus live alerts on your own bags and more checks. Pay in SOL, or hold $ZOOAGENCY.
items.why: If nobody pays for it, we have not proven anyone needs it. This is how we find out, in public.

zh.title: 专业版
zh.text: 判断结论和主要理由对所有人一直免费。专业版开放深度透视：所有钱包、前五秒雷达、谁给开发者打的钱，以及你持仓代币的实时提醒和更多检查次数。用 SOL 支付，或者持有 $ZOOAGENCY。
zh.why: 如果没人愿意付费，就说明我们还没证明有人需要它。这就是我们公开验证的方式。

items.title: Holders' vote, round one
items.text: Holders choose which of December's two builds comes first. Each vote signed by a wallet and published, the result hashed on chain.
items.why: The gene vote already works this way inside the nursery. Now it decides the product.

zh.title: 持有者投票 · 第一轮
zh.text: 持有者决定十二月两个项目哪个先做。每一票由钱包签名并公开，结果的哈希写在链上。
zh.why: 基因投票已经在育婴室里这样运行。现在由它来决定产品。

items.title: ZOO Guard for agents
items.text: One call before every swap: who is behind this coin. If the answer is avoid, the swap does not go through. Agents pay per check, a fraction of a cent, through x402.
items.why: AI agents trade real money with nobody watching. To a bundler they are the easiest buyers on the chain. Agents pay per call without thinking twice, so checks stay free for people.

zh.title: ZOO 守卫 · 给智能体
zh.text: 每次兑换前调用一次：这个币背后是谁。如果结论是避开，交易就不会执行。智能体通过 x402 按次付费，每次不到一美分。
zh.why: AI 智能体在无人看管的情况下用真钱交易。对捆绑者来说，它们是链上最好收割的买家。智能体按次付费不会犹豫，所以对人的检查可以一直免费。

items.title: Morning Brief everywhere
items.text: The Morning Brief posted on its own to X and Telegram every morning, the same issue that lands on the site.

zh.title: 早报全网发布
zh.text: 早报每天早上自动发到 X 和 Telegram，和网站上的是同一期。

items.title: Caller Truth
items.text: We line up the minute a caller posts with the wallets that bought before it and sold into the people who followed. Every caller gets a record, and the extension shows it next to their name on X.
items.why: Trackers show a caller's trades. Nobody lines them up against the post itself.

zh.title: 喊单者真相
zh.text: 把喊单者发帖的那一分钟，和在帖子之前买入、再卖给跟单者的钱包对齐。每个喊单者都有公开战绩，插件会在 X 上把它显示在名字旁边。
zh.why: 现有工具只显示喊单者的交易，没有人把交易和帖子本身对齐。

items.title: Agent passports
items.text: A public record for every agent token on ClawPump: does the agent really act, does the creator claim the fees and sell them, what the creator wallet does after launch. A badge any launchpad can show.
items.why: Agent tokens are sold on what the agent does. Nobody checks that it does it.

zh.title: 智能体护照
zh.text: 为 ClawPump 上每个智能体代币建立公开记录：智能体是否真的在运作，创建者是否领取并卖掉手续费，发射后创建者钱包在做什么。任何发射平台都能展示的徽章。
zh.why: 智能体代币卖的是智能体能做什么，但没有人核实它真的在做。

items.title: Our verdicts against outside data
items.text: Our calls run against independent rug labels from published research, and the result posted whether it flatters us or not.

zh.title: 用外部数据检验我们的判断
zh.text: 用已发表研究里独立的跑路标注来检验我们的判断，不管结果好不好看都公开。

items.title: Our numbers, quarter one
items.text: Every trap caught, every call we got wrong, every number on this page checked against what happened.

zh.title: 第一季度的数字
zh.text: 抓到的每个陷阱，判断错的每一次，这一页上的每个数字都和实际发生的对照。

items.title: Guard in ClawPump's agent tools
items.text: Guard as an MCP tool, one line in an agent's config, offered to the launchpad we came from.
items.why: This one depends on ClawPump, so it says exploring until they say yes.

zh.title: 守卫进入 ClawPump 智能体工具
zh.text: 守卫作为 MCP 工具，在智能体配置里加一行就能用，提供给我们出身的发射平台。
zh.why: 这一项取决于 ClawPump，所以在他们同意之前标为探索中。

items.title: Guard inside trading terminals
items.text: Our verdict inside the terminals people already trade on.
items.why: Depends on partners, so it stays exploring until a deal is signed.

zh.title: 守卫进入交易终端
zh.text: 在大家已经在用的交易终端里直接看到我们的判断。
zh.why: 取决于合作方，签约之前一直标为探索中。

buried.title: Paying the agents in tokens
buried.text: Holders would spend the token to feed the agents: model calls, stakes and signal fees settled on chain.
buried.reason: Paying for every check is a barrier for a trader who needs an answer in a second.

zh.title: 用代币给智能体付费
zh.text: 持有者花代币喂养智能体：模型调用、质押和信号费用在链上结算。
zh.reason: 每次检查都要付费，对一个需要一秒内得到答案的交易者来说是门槛。

buried.title: A list of safe coins
buried.text: A feed of coins that passed every check, sold as alpha.
buried.reason: A clean x-ray means we caught nothing, not that the coin lives. Coins we flag avoid and coins with no flags die at almost the same rate. The next rug on a green list would be on us.

zh.title: 安全币清单
zh.text: 把通过全部检查的币做成清单，当作内幕信息卖。
zh.reason: 干净的透视只说明我们没抓到问题，不代表币能活下来。被我们标为避开的币和没有红旗的币，死亡率几乎一样。绿名单上的下一个跑路，责任就在我们。

buried.title: A wallet watchlist
buried.text: Follow any wallet and get pinged on its every move.
buried.reason: A dozen bots already follow wallets. Another alert feed is not why anyone opens an x-ray.

zh.title: 钱包关注列表
zh.text: 关注任意钱包，它每动一下都提醒你。
zh.reason: 已经有十几个机器人在跟踪钱包。多一个提醒频道，不是大家打开透视的理由。

buried.title: A separate API page
buried.text: Its own page for the API, apart from everything else for builders.
buried.reason: The API lives on /connect beside everything else a builder needs. Two doors to one room was one too many.

zh.title: 单独的 API 页面
zh.text: 给 API 单独做一个页面，和其他开发者内容分开。
zh.reason: API 放在 /connect，和开发者需要的其他东西在一起。一个房间开两扇门，多了一扇。
